fusions.name: Paper Catches
fusions.desc: A burst of fire round you that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Cinder Lancet
fusions.desc: Hits a target up to 6 tiles away: it deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, and has a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Too Hot to Swat
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and sets them [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fanning the Welt
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your damage rises by 12%. You have 10% fire resistance.
